svg.title: GeniusLocus full architectural taxonomy
svg.desc: Six layers from publication artifacts down to storage modes, with the six-rung representation ladder per drawer shown separately.
svg.text: GeniusLocus taxonomy as it stands after 2026-05-07 scope
Layer 1 — what gets published to the world
Layer 2 — deployment products built on the engine
Layer 3 — framework profiles loaded at estate creation
Layer 5 — universal lattice (committed v1: UDC + Wikidata)
Estates declare a zoom window into this lattice. Federation overlap = window comparison.
Layer 6 — hierarchy (Estate → Wing → Room → Drawer, top-down read)

g.text: Estate — property line of one knower, has manifest, has zoom window
Wing — major life domain or knowledge area, metadata string
Room — specific topic or named category, metadata string

svg.text: Layer 7 — six representation rungs per drawer (model+version tagged)

g.text: Rung 5 — lane tag (life-domain or framework role; cheap, capture-time)
Rung 3 — embedding vector (CoreML; cheap MiniLM at capture-time)
Rung 1.5 — KG propositions (expensive, links to GeniusLocusKit)
Rung 1 — verbatim text (sacred, never lossy compressed)
